passages.note: Senate concurrence/final passage vote, 22-6-1; McCay voted Yea on a single-subject parental-access bill.
passages.actor_quote: Kennedy, M. McCay, D. McKell, M.

passages.provision_quote: without written parental consent make changes to a student's education record
passages.note: Operative text guarantees parental access to education records and bars record changes on gender identity without written parental consent; it neither requires proactive notification (rung 4) nor governs staff use of names/pronouns (rung 5), so it shows only the parental-involvement side.

rows.reasoning: McCay voted Yea on SB 100 (2023), which bars schools from shielding education records from parents and from changing a record's gender identity "without written parental consent make changes to a student's education record". That places him on the parental-involvement side, but the bill's object is the education record, not staff use of a different name or pronouns ("Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns"), and it does not require schools to notify parents, so it does not separate rungs 3, 4 and 5.
